options.name: authmode
options.description: Authentication Server ('Local Database' means local (Default)), use name of configured ldap or radius server

options.name: dashboardavailablewidgetspanel
options.description: Show the Available Widgets panel on the Dashboard.

options.name: dashboardcolumns
options.description: Dashboard columns

options.name: disablealiaspopupdetail
options.description: If selected, the details in alias popups will not be shown, just the alias description (e.g. in Firewall Rules).

options.name: dns_addresses
options.description: DNS IP addresses, separated by space

options.name: dns_gateways
options.description: DNS gateways, separated by space. You can use none for empty values.

options.name: dns_hostnames
options.description: DNS hostnames, separated by space. You can use none for empty values.

options.name: dnsallowoverride
options.description: Allow DNS server list to be overridden by DHCP/PPP on WAN

options.name: dnslocalhost
options.description: Do not use the DNS Forwarder/DNS Resolver as a DNS server for the firewall. "" Use local DNS (127.0.0.1), fall back to remote DNS servers (Default) "local" Use local DNS (127.0.0), ignore remote DNS servers "remote" Use remote DNS server, ignore local DNS true will be mapped to "remote" false will be mapped to ""

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain name of the firewall host

options.name: hostname
options.description: Hostname of the firewall host, without domain part

options.name: interfacessort
options.description: If selected, lists of interfaces will be sorted by description, otherwise they are listed wan,lan,optn...

options.name: language
options.description: Language for the webConfigurator.

options.name: logincss
options.description: Color for the login page as six digit hexadecimal string e.g. V(33ffb2)

options.name: loginshowhost
options.description: Show hostname on login banner

options.name: requirestatefilter
options.description: This option requires a filter to be entered before the states are displayed.

options.name: roworderdragging
options.description: Disables dragging rows to allow selecting and copying row contents and avoid accidental changes.

options.name: session_timeout
options.description: Time in minutes to expire idle management sessions. The default is 4 hours (240 minutes). Use 0 to never expire sessions. NOTE: This is a security risk!

options.name: shellauth
options.description: Use Authentication Server for Shell Authentication. Default is false.

options.name: statusmonitoringsettingspanel
options.description: Show the Settings panel in Status Monitoring.

options.name: systemlogsfilterpanel
options.description: Show the Log Filter panel in System Logs.

options.name: systemlogsmanagelogpanel
options.description: Show the Manage Log panel in System Logs.

options.name: timeservers
options.description: Time servers, separated by space

options.name: timezone
options.description: Select a geographic region name (Continent/Location) to determine the timezone for the firewall.

options.name: webguicss
options.description: Choose an alternative CSS file (if installed) to change the appearance of the webConfigurator. Custom themes are also supported. If you want to use a custom pfsense CSS theme you need to upload it to the appliance first. Standard choices are 'pfsense', 'pfsense-dark','pfsense-dark-BETA','pfsense-BETA', and 'Compact-RED'.

options.name: webguifixedmenu
options.description: When enabled, menu remains visible at top of page

options.name: webguihostnamemenu
options.description: Replaces the Help menu title in the Navbar with the system hostname or FQDN.

options.name: webguileftcolumnhyper
options.description: If selected, clicking a label in the left column will select/toggle the first item of the group.
